title: No test drives the ADR-0105 carry from the real recovery through ship's later stages; the missing proof is how no carry ever shipped
summary: ADR-0105 named a proof test for the carry, TestFleetRebase_Cycle1701Shape_ShipsWithoutBuildOrAudit, that was never written, and without it no carry shipped: cycles 1766, 1768 and 1772 each carried and were refused at verifyAuditBinding's predicate-execution check (fixed 2026-09-30). The new TestVerifyAuditBinding_ShipsACarriedRebaseWithoutASecondAudit proves the ship-side binding with a record written by a test helper and stops at verifyAuditBinding; no test, live or at Run level, has taken a carry written by identityCarryForward through verifyStagedTree (pre-commit), verifyCommittedTree (post-push) and the ship binding (architecture review of that fix, MEDIUM-3).
fix: Add a Run-level test: a lane audits, a peer lands, ship meets the moved main, the recovery unwinds, rebases and runs identityCarryForward (with the composed-gate runner stubbed green), and ship lands with no Build or Audit round; assert the carry record, the accepted-drift log line and the landed tree.
acceptance: A Run-level test ships a byte-identical rebase through the real recovery with no second audit
ADR-0105 step 4 names that test and no longer lists the proof as open
source: console, 2026-09-30 architecture review of the verifyExecutionTree carry fix (MEDIUM-3)
